name: hot_standby_feedback
description: Enables feedback from a hot standby to the primary to prevent query cancellations due to WAL cleanup, by informing the primary of running queries on the standby.
symptoms: replication lag spikes due to WAL retention pressure
tuning_tips: Enable only when standby query cancellations are observed; monitor for bloat and WAL growth. Disable if bloat or WAL pressure becomes problematic.
